title: Git-governed terminal cleanup
facts: Active correlation state is stored privately and temporarily in Amazon S3.
Terminal decisions are stored as public-safe GitHub tombstones.
GitHub Actions invokes Cleanup Lambda through short-lived OIDC credentials.
Cleanup Lambda conditionally deletes only an expected active-state revision.
questions: Is the authority for terminal decisions explicit?
Can a stale tombstone delete newer active state?
Does the portfolio remain useful when AWS is unavailable?
